stem.timeline.opened_sr: Opened Timeline Studio in a new window.
stem.timeline.thinking: ✨ Reading the text and finding dated events…

stem.timeline.noevents: No clear dated events were found in that text. Try a passage with years or dates.
stem.timeline.needsai: AI hints are off, so opening the manual timeline builder instead — add events by hand.
stem.timeline.blocked: Pop-up blocked — allow pop-ups for this page and try again.

stem.timeline.error: Something went wrong generating the timeline:
stem.timeline.title: 🕰️ Timeline Studio — turn a reading into a timeline
stem.timeline.blurb: Paste a reading — a history handout, a biography, the story of a scientific discovery — and the AI finds the dated events and lays them out as an interactive timeline you can scroll and step through. Great for turning dense text into a clear sequence.
stem.timeline.source_label: Paste the text to turn into a timeline
stem.timeline.placeholder: Paste a passage with dates — e.g. a chapter on the Space Race, a scientist’s biography, the events of a novel…
stem.timeline.generate_title: Generate an interactive timeline from the pasted text
stem.timeline.build_title: Open the timeline window to build one by hand
stem.timeline.ai_on: AI is ON — it reads your text and pulls out the dated events.
stem.timeline.ai_off: AI hints are off — use “Build by hand” to add events yourself in the timeline window.
stem.timeline.privacy: Your text and the timeline stay in memory — nothing is saved or graded.
stem.timeline.credit: Timeline rendering: TimelineJS by Northwestern University Knight Lab (timeline.knightlab.com), free and open source under the Mozilla Public License. The timeline library loads from Knight Lab’s CDN, so this tool needs internet.
